messages.content:
Hello! I'm so excited to be working with you on your Food Delivery app project. I understand that you're looking to create a clone of Swiggy, a popular food delivery platform, and you're planning to use it for solo customers ordering from restaurants.

As your Business Analyst, my goal is to help you turn your idea into a clear, testable plan that the rest of the team can build from. I'll ask some questions to clarify your vision and ensure we're on the same page. I want to make sure we capture everything you need to make your app a success.

Before we dive in, I just want to confirm that I have a good understanding of your project's goals. You're aiming to launch the app within the next 2 weeks, with a budget of $70,000 for everything. Is that correct?

Mind if I ask a few questions to get started?
